_note: South Carolina 2026 election cycle: key dates and official links for the November 3, 2026 general election. Each date was read on the official page in key_date_sources on the day in key_date_retrieved. The U.S. Senate, U.S. House and Governor races list every candidate on the state's certified list for the November 3 ballot (roster_source_url on each race), in alphabetical order by last name; write-in candidates are not listed.
